artikel.titel: Spain’s election promises collide with a shrinking fiscal margin
artikel.text: EUROPE: Spain's main political parties, PSOE, PP and Vox, propose different mixes of spending, tax cuts and reform, but the financing behind their pledges remains unclear. Spain has limited scope to find savings from already low public spending, while its tax burden constrains broad-based cuts. Rising ageing costs will add further pressure over time

artikel.titel: Poland’s imported inflation meets a cooling domestic economy
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: October data points to a loss of momentum in Poland’s economy, with weak industrial and construction output and a cooling labour market. Inflation remains elevated, but the energy shock has yet to generate indirect or second-round effects. The central bank is ready to hike rates if needed, but does it need to?

artikel.titel: Eurozone growth maintains its pace as France weakens further
artikel.text: EUROPE: The eurozone composite PMI for November was unchanged at 51.7 from October, indicating that the economy is continuing to truck along at a decent pace. Weakness in France is being offset elsewhere, most notably by optimism in Germany

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Uneasy calm as markets stabilise
artikel.text: After a frenetic week of tech-led selling that dragged the S&P 500 index nearly 9% lower, equity futures are marked 2% higher today. Equity corrections have tended to be short, sharp affairs since a major rally started in 2022, and investors will be hoping the worst is over. The challenge will be another hot US inflation print this week. USD is set to hold gains

artikel.titel: Metals sell-off runs ahead of physical markets
artikel.text: It has been a difficult week for metals. Copper is down more than 8%, aluminium almost 6% and gold around 9% as a stronger dollar, higher rate expectations and weaker risk appetite weigh on the complex

artikel.titel: CEE & CCA week ahead: Polish activity data and Czech confidence in focus
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Poland will release industrial output, labour market and retail sales data, while Czech confidence indicators are expected to show weaker consumer sentiment but a modest improvement in business confidence
Our Q&A explores where ING’s Global Outlook differs from market expectations, from the path for interest rates and inflation to US debt, European fiscal risks, wages and gold

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Carry trade unwind in full swing
artikel.text: The prospect of faster Fed tightening and continued dislocation in tech stocks is sucking funds into the dollar and the yen. Popular FX carry trade positions are being unwound across the board. Given that a hawkish Fed lies at the heart of the current correction in risk assets, and there are no signs of Fed rhetoric softening anytime soon, USD can stay strong

artikel.titel: Asia week ahead: BoK rate decision, data from China, Taiwan, Japan
artikel.text: ASIA/PACIFIC: The Bank of Korea is expected to hike rates by 25bp to 3.25%. Markets will also closely watch key regional data releases, including China’s industrial profits, Taiwan’s industrial production, and Tokyo inflation

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Higher US real rates dominate
artikel.text: US short-dated real interest rates are pushing back to their highest levels since 2023 as markets get the message that the Fed is ready to apply the brakes. These high real rates are sucking funds out of asset classes like precious metals and are triggering a broader fallout across emerging market currencies. There is no reason to fight this trend near term
